primary_documentation.claim: ESearch returns UIDs matching a text query; PubMed field tags and query syntax are database-specific.
ESummary returns document summaries for supplied UIDs and supports JSON output.
NCBI recommends no more than three E-utilities URL requests per second; this tool performs at most two sequential requests per invocation.
PubMed disclaimer: NLM indexes material published by other organizations; database inclusion is not endorsement, and users must examine copyright and licensing restrictions for linked material.
NCBI scripting guidance requires its Disclaimer and Copyright notice to be evident to service users, recommends tool and email parameters, and caps E-utilities requests at three per second per IP.

differentiation.difference: This adapter queries the PubMed Entrez database with PubMed field-tag syntax and returns bounded ESummary records. Europe PMC remains a distinct database/API source; an exact PMID/DOI resolver is not query-to-record search.

dependency_status.permission_default: OFF; explicit host permission and per-invocation flag required

claim_ceiling: API interface and provider-returned metadata fields only; no source authenticity, relevance, completeness, evidence support, scientific validity, or provider superiority.
